test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word/phrase in the given sentence.

Beyond skills, experience, and training, companies search for applicants who display excitement — those they believe __shall carry out allocated responsibilities__ cheerfully and cooperatively.

options.text: shall take up any designated obligations
should pick up all tasks and works

solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 2'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

In Option 2 "Will execute assigned duties" is the most appropriate substitute as it conveys the idea of performing tasks that have been allocated, aligning well with the context of the sentence.

Hence, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: "Shall take up any designated obligations" is less concise and not commonly used in this context.
 
• Option 3: "Will demonstrate non-biased work" does not fit as it shifts the focus to fairness rather than the excitement and cooperation mentioned in the sentence.
 
• Option 4: "Should pick up all tasks and works" is vague and grammatically awkward in this context.
